name: plan-generosity-hoh1
about: Pelor's Fury on the HoH1 tower's bosses (plan_generosity bot, section hoh1): each boss floor of hwp_forsaken_tower_hoh1 loaded and its fight started the way the HoH1 level does, then a god-mode Paladin of Generosity's Fury through the skill's own Activate on every boss unit: held, or (a boss that cannot be targeted or buffed then, by design) refused with the stacks, mana and cooldown kept; while held no skill of the boss but a triggered or aura one is casting and it stays put; armor and resistances 0; the 60 s boss cooldown; 4 beams or more; no script error. Needs the HoH1 import. kwargs only: a comma list of boss levels (boss_mines, ...).

steps.name: hoh1.content on (off by default; saved with the town)
